agentic_stratum.reason: Hierarchical planner/sub-agent credit changes the execution unit and cannot be isolated by a minimal arithmetic hook in the core stratum.

primary_metric: paired seed-level heldout_score difference versus grpo

analysis.confidence_interval: paired seed bootstrap, 10000 resamples, RNG seed 20260714
analysis.multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg over four core arm-versus-GRPO tests

verdicts.RETAINS: 95% CI excludes zero and its lower bound is at least 50% of a metric-compatible published delta
verdicts.SURVIVES: 95% CI excludes zero but no metric-compatible published delta exists or the half-gain rule fails
verdicts.DISAPPEARS: 90% CI lies inside the equivalence margin and achieved 80%-power MDE does not exceed that margin
verdicts.REVERSES: 95% CI upper bound is below zero
verdicts.INCONCLUSIVE: all other outcomes, including inadequate power
